contracts.title: Policy Integrity
contracts.requirement: Every protected decision MUST identify policy version and establish integrity through a deployment-trusted mechanism before use.

contracts.title: Capability Authorization
contracts.requirement: Every protected action MUST be authorized for authenticated principal, exact action, target, and scope. Missing authority MUST NOT be inferred.

contracts.title: Enforcement Mediation
contracts.requirement: Every declared protected side-effect path MUST traverse an enforcement boundary that cannot be bypassed within the stated threat model.

contracts.title: Fail-Closed Decision
contracts.requirement: Missing, malformed, unknown, expired, unavailable, or contradictory authorization inputs MUST NOT authorize a protected action.

contracts.title: Provenance and Authority Separation
contracts.requirement: Untrusted content, tool output, memory, and peer messages MUST NOT create or elevate identity, policy, capability, or approval authority.

contracts.title: Identity and Revocation
contracts.requirement: Protected actions MUST require independently authenticated identities with valid, in-scope, non-revoked credentials.

contracts.title: Delegation Attenuation
contracts.requirement: Delegated authority MUST be a subset of delegator authority and preserve subject, audience, scope, expiry, and revocation constraints.

contracts.title: Evidence Integrity
contracts.requirement: Evidence MUST be ordered, integrity-verifiable, attributable, and protected against undetected modification within declared storage and checkpoint assumptions.

contracts.title: Recovery Integrity
contracts.requirement: Restored application data MUST NOT automatically restore identity credentials, keys, revocation state, policy authority, or trust decisions.

contracts.title: Responsible Capability
contracts.requirement: Capabilities outside authority or presenting unacceptable risk MUST be denied, restricted, or separately approved; model output alone MUST NOT authorize execution.
